before.zh: 他从小在乡下长大，对农村生活很熟悉。
before.en: He grew up in the countryside and knows rural life well.

after.zh: 他在城里工作了十年，最后还是决定回乡种地。
after.en: After ten years working in the city, he finally decided to go back to his village and farm.

why: example only showed 乡 inside the separate word 乡下; now uses 乡 itself (回乡)

before.zh: 他住的病房里有三张床，都住满了病人。
before.en: The ward he's in has three beds, all occupied by patients.

after.zh: 他住的病房里一共有三张病床，另外两张也都住了人。
after.en: The ward he's in has three beds, and the other two are occupied as well.

why: "有三张床，都住满了病人" is awkward (a bed is not "filled up" with patients)

before.zh: 我们小区门口新开了一家超市，明天正式开业。
before.en: A new supermarket has opened at the entrance to our neighbourhood; it officially opens for business tomorrow.

after.zh: 我们小区门口那家超市装修好了，明天正式开业。
after.en: The supermarket at the entrance to our neighbourhood has finished its fit-out and officially opens tomorrow.

why: "新开了一家超市，明天正式开业" contradicts itself (already opened vs opens tomorrow)

before.zh: 太阳给地球带来了光和热量。
before.en: The sun brings light and heat to the earth.

after.zh: 穿羽绒服可以减少身体热量的散失。
after.en: Wearing a down jacket reduces the loss of body heat.

why: "光和热量" is unidiomatic; the set phrase is 光和热, so the sentence taught a wrong collocation

before.zh: 会员在本店购物可以享受九折的折扣。
before.en: Members get a ten percent discount when shopping in our store.

after.zh: 如果一次买得多，老板一般都会给点折扣。
after.en: If you buy a lot at once, the owner will usually give you a bit of a discount.

why: "享受九折的折扣" is redundant (九折 already is the discount); natural is 享受九折优惠

before.zh: 每年春节前，都有大批人回老家过年。
before.en: Every year before the Spring Festival, huge numbers of people go home for the holiday.

after.zh: 每年春节前，都有大批在外打工的人回老家过年。
after.en: Every year before the Spring Festival, huge numbers of migrant workers go home for the holiday.

why: bare "大批人" is unidiomatic; 大批 wants a modified noun phrase

before.zh: 明天你就要出国了，祝你一路顺风！
before.en: You're going abroad tomorrow; have a safe trip!

after.zh: 你明天就要坐火车回老家了，祝你一路顺风！
after.en: You're taking the train home tomorrow, so have a safe trip!

why: wishing 一路顺风 to someone flying abroad is a known faux pas (planes take off into a headwind); moved to a train trip

before.zh: 情人节那天，他请女朋友去一家高级西餐厅吃饭。
before.en: On Valentine's Day he took his girlfriend to an upmarket Western restaurant.

after.zh: 他吃不惯西餐，总觉得牛排没有中国菜香。
after.en: He can't get used to Western food; he always feels steak isn't as tasty as Chinese dishes.

why: blank fell inside the compound 西餐厅 ("高级＿＿厅"), so the quiz did not test the word on its own

before.zh: 工作要分清轻重缓急，先做最重要的事。
before.en: At work you need to prioritise and do the most important things first.

after.zh: 做事要分清轻重，先把最要紧的事办完。
after.en: You need to know what matters most and get the most urgent things done first.

why: example only showed 轻重 inside the idiom 轻重缓急; now uses 分清轻重 on its own

before.zh: 我国自主研制的大型客机已经成功试飞。
before.en: The large passenger jet developed independently by our country has completed a successful test flight.

after.zh: 一九六四年，中国第一颗原子弹研制成功。
after.en: In 1964, China successfully developed its first atomic bomb.

why: ambiguous blank: 研发 (same batch) fits "自主研发的大型客机" equally well

before.zh: 政府正在制订新的政策，帮助小企业渡过难关。
before.en: The government is drawing up new policies to help small businesses through hard times.

after.zh: 老师根据每个学生的情况，制订了不同的学习计划。
after.en: Based on each student's situation, the teacher drew up a different study plan for each.

why: ambiguous blank: 制定 (same sound) is the standard verb for 政策; 制订 belongs with 计划/方案

before.zh: 这次旅行加深了我对中国文化的理解。
before.en: This trip deepened my understanding of Chinese culture.

after.zh: 这条河太浅，船过不去，得把河道加深一些。
after.en: This river is too shallow for boats to get through; the channel needs to be deepened.

why: ambiguous blank: 增进 (same batch) fits "增进了我对中国文化的理解" equally well; also near-duplicate of the example
"pemalu" means shy, not timid/cowardly

before.zh: 适量喝茶对身体是有益的。
before.en: Drinking tea in moderation is good for your health.

after.zh: 适量喝茶对身体是有益的，但不要喝得太浓。
after.en: Drinking tea in moderation is good for you, but don't drink it too strong.

why: example was 11 characters, below the 12-character minimum; lengthened naturally

before.zh: 这家工厂有两千多名职工。
before.en: This factory has more than two thousand workers.

after.zh: 这家工厂规模很大，有两千多名职工。
after.en: This is a big factory with more than two thousand workers.

why: example was 11 characters, below the 12-character minimum; lengthened naturally

before.zh: 大爷，请问去火车站怎么走？
before.en: Excuse me, sir, how do I get to the train station?

after.zh: 大爷，请问去火车站应该怎么走？
after.en: Excuse me, sir, which way is it to the train station?

why: example was 11 characters, below the 12-character minimum; lengthened naturally

before.zh: 山上的树木长得非常茂盛。
before.en: The trees on the mountain are growing very thickly.

after.zh: 这里雨水充足，山上的树木长得非常茂盛。
after.en: There is plenty of rain here, and the trees on the mountain grow very thickly.

why: example was 11 characters, below the 12-character minimum; lengthened naturally

before.zh: 大熊猫是中国特有的动物。
before.en: The giant panda is an animal found only in China.

after.zh: 大熊猫是中国特有的珍稀动物。
after.en: The giant panda is a rare animal found only in China.

why: example was 11 characters, below the 12-character minimum; lengthened naturally

before.zh: 这种新方法既高效又节能。
before.en: This new method is both efficient and energy-saving.

after.zh: 工厂采用的这种新方法既高效又节能。
after.en: The new method the factory has adopted is both efficient and energy-saving.

why: example was 11 characters, below the 12-character minimum; lengthened naturally

before.zh: 妈妈在窗台上摆了几盆花。
before.en: Mum has put a few pots of flowers on the windowsill.

after.zh: 妈妈在客厅的窗台上摆了几盆花。
after.en: Mum has put a few pots of flowers on the living-room windowsill.

why: example was 11 characters, below the 12-character minimum; lengthened naturally

before.zh: 他去过中国的大部分省份。
before.en: He has been to most of China's provinces.

after.zh: 他很喜欢旅游，已经去过中国的大部分省份。
after.en: He loves travelling and has already been to most of China's provinces.

why: example was 11 characters, below the 12-character minimum; lengthened naturally
